raw_translation: Hii ya ndani mbili-mchezaji utekelezaji hutumia kawaida harakati na kuangalia sheria. Haijumuishi mpinzani kompyuta, online kucheza au mashindano ya uamuzi kwa ajili ya kurudia na kuangalia daima. Sheria tukio inaweza kutofautiana. Hakuna kitu ni kupakuliwa au kuokolewa.
source: This local two-player implementation uses standard movement and check rules. It does not include a computer opponent, online play or tournament adjudication for repetition and perpetual checks. Event rules may differ. Nothing is uploaded or saved.
translation: Hii ya ndani mbili-mchezaji utekelezaji hutumia kawaida harakati na kuangalia sheria. Haijumuishi mpinzani kompyuta, online kucheza au mashindano ya uamuzi kwa ajili ya kurudia na kuangalia daima. Sheria tukio inaweza kutofautiana. Hakuna kitu ni kupakuliwa au kuokolewa.
